Snail caviar

Rated 4.8 out of 5from 126 reviews

$59$11.80 for 10 g

The pearl-white eggs of our land snails, salted by hand on the day they are collected. Mild and clean, with a taste of the forest after rain.

Size
Jars 1

Up to six jars an order, so the batch lasts the month.

  • Courier in Kyiv, todayOrder by 12:00. $9, free from $150.
  • Farm shop pickup, freeFarm road 4, Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00
  • In a chilled boxIt keeps the jar at 2 °C for a day

Land snails lay their eggs in the soil of the beds, about a hundred at a time. We lift them by hand, rinse them in spring water and salt them the same day, so the pearls stay firm and white.

  • Eggs, sea salt and nothing else
  • Pearls of 3 to 4 mm, about 1,500 in a 50 g jar
  • Every jar carries its batch number and the day it was packed

Take the jar from the fridge ten minutes before you open it. Serve it with a spoon of shell, bone or wood: metal leaves a taste of tin.

A heaped teaspoon, about 5 g, is one serving. Put it on a warm blin with sour cream, on half a boiled egg, or eat it from the spoon with a glass of cold dry white.

The courier brings the jar in a chilled box the same day if you order by 12:00, and calls ten minutes before arriving. At the farm shop on Farm road 4 the jar waits for you in the cold room.

Unopened, the jar keeps three months at 0 to 4 °C. Once it is open, close it again and eat it within three days. Do not freeze it: the pearls burst.

From our beds near Kyiv

About 4,000 snails live in open-air beds behind the farm shop. We collect the eggs by hand from March to October and give every collection a number.
